description: Migrate the extension to a root-managed single-package WXT codebase with TypeScript, ESM, and Chrome+Firefox parity.

tasks.title: Flatten package management to root
tasks.description: Merge src/package.json into the root package.json, remove the workspace setup, and make Bun, Playwright, ESLint, and test scripts run from root without changing extension runtime behavior. Acceptance: one active package.json, bun test runs from root, legacy non-WXT scripts still function from root.

tasks.title: Add WXT scaffold and root config
tasks.description: Add WXT to the root toolchain, create wxt.config.ts, and establish the initial root-managed WXT project shape while keeping src as the temporary source root. Acceptance: WXT config exists, root scripts can invoke WXT, and the repo has a stable root-managed extension scaffold.

tasks.title: Recreate manifest behavior in WXT
tasks.description: Translate the raw manifest and browser-specific build differences into WXT config, preserving permissions, commands, icons, popup/options paths, and web accessible resources. Acceptance: WXT emits Chrome and Firefox manifests with parity to current behavior, including explicit Firefox handling and page-context WAR output.

tasks.title: Define core TypeScript domain types
tasks.description: Introduce typed core domain models for extension options, article/content payloads, download tracking state, library state, and agent bridge state. Acceptance: shared runtime code can import concrete TS types instead of ad hoc object shapes and new type definitions compile cleanly.

tasks.title: Convert pure shared modules to TS ESM
tasks.description: Convert pure shared utilities such as count-utils, search-core, site-rules, popup-batch-utils, notifications, obsidian-utils, and download-tracker to TypeScript and ESM. Acceptance: converted modules use import/export only, preserve current behavior, and their unit tests continue to pass.

tasks.title: Convert stateful shared modules to TS ESM
tasks.description: Convert shared modules with current require/global fallbacks such as template-utils, url-utils, library-export, options-state, library-state, agent-bridge-state, and markdown-options by replacing implicit runtime lookups with explicit imports or injected dependencies. Acceptance: these modules no longer rely on globalThis.snipSnip* for normal operation and continue to satisfy existing tests.

tasks.title: Wrap vendored runtime libraries
tasks.description: Add stable wrapper modules around vendored runtime dependencies such as Readability, Turndown, Turndown GFM, moment, highlight, and browser polyfill so migrated TS/ESM code can consume them without script-order coupling. Acceptance: runtime entrypoints can import wrapper modules instead of depending on raw global side effects.

tasks.title: Migrate background and messaging
tasks.description: Convert service-worker.js into a WXT background entrypoint, replace importScripts ordering with imports, and extract typed message handlers/contracts. Acceptance: listeners register synchronously, command/context-menu/download behavior still works, and no background path depends on importScripts order.

tasks.title: Migrate content script and page bridge
tasks.description: Move the content script to a WXT content entrypoint and convert the page-context bridge to an explicitly injected web-accessible script while preserving MathJax/custom-event behavior, DOM capture, and link picker flows. Acceptance: content script loads correctly, page bridge injection works, and end-to-end capture behavior remains intact.

tasks.title: Migrate offscreen with Firefox fallback
tasks.description: Convert the offscreen document to a WXT-managed entrypoint, use capability-gated Chromium offscreen behavior, and preserve a functioning Firefox fallback path. Acceptance: Chrome uses offscreen successfully, Firefox fallback does not crash, and HTML-to-Markdown conversion regressions remain covered.

tasks.title: Migrate popup to TS ESM entrypoint
tasks.description: Convert popup bootstrap code to a WXT popup entrypoint while preserving the existing HTML/CSS structure and replacing script-order dependencies with explicit imports. Acceptance: popup clipping, preview, batch flow, and agent-related actions work as before.

tasks.title: Migrate options and guide pages
tasks.description: Convert options and guide bootstraps to WXT-managed TS/ESM entrypoints, preserving current HTML/CSS structure and replacing global bootstrap order with imports. Acceptance: options restore/save/search/import/export flows work, guide page still loads and behaves correctly, and duplicate popup/options defaults are reduced to shared typed sources where applicable.

tasks.title: Remove legacy manifest and build scripts
tasks.description: Delete obsolete manifest-generation and copy/build scripts once WXT parity is confirmed, and make WXT the only packaging/build path. Acceptance: release/build flows no longer depend on generate-browser-manifests.js or other legacy extension packaging logic.

tasks.title: Stabilize tests and typecheck
tasks.description: Update Bun tests, Playwright paths, and root typecheck configuration for the migrated WXT/TS/ESM layout. Acceptance: bun test passes from root, Playwright targets the approved WXT output or equivalent path, and the active migrated codebase passes root typecheck.
